population.coverage: All original epochs, including movement and unknown intervals; five class probabilities per epoch.

control.boundary_scope: Invented operator-file read/write denial, environment-secret absence, parent process-argument sysctl denial, localhost network denial and process-creation denial under the same sandbox policy as the scripted clients.

runtime.scope: Selected source and runtime identities; not authentication of every dynamic library or provider execution.

observed_resources.scope: Recorded CPU/RAM snapshots and logical file extents, with one numeric thread declared through admission/environment settings; no OS thread cap or continuous RSS guarantee. preserved_failed_attempt.cause: The system Python developer-tool launcher required an unallowed toolchain library; the sandbox denied it.
preserved_failed_attempt.resolution: A separately reviewed attempt used the already installed framework interpreter, without widening the sandbox or changing the public transport/viewer source. The external driver and runtime selection changed.

independent_review.scope: Verified source/runtime/protocol/lease identities, all saved file hashes, wire/action correspondence, PNG framing and CRCs, complete uniform response arrays, recorded resource limits and absence of failure markers. No signal reread, rendering or collector rerun.
independent_review.evidence_availability: Operator-held artifacts are identified by hashes; raw inputs, images, responses, local paths and credentials are not published in this receipt.
